product_name: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion (Pantone Blue Surf, 8GB RAM, 128GB Storage) | 6.78" 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED Display | Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 | 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 OIS | 32MP Selfie | 7000mAh Battery | 68W TurboPower |
description: Powerful Performance – Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 processor with 8GB RAM ensures smooth multitasking, gaming and fast performance. Massive 7000mAh Battery – Long-lasting silicon-carbon battery with 68W TurboPower fast charging support for extended usage. 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED Display – Quad-curved display with 144Hz refresh rate and up to 5200 nits brightness for smooth visuals. Pro-Grade Camera System – 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 main camera with OIS + 13MP ultra-wide lens for detailed photos. 32MP Front Camera – High-resolution selfie camera with 4K video recording support. Premium Pantone Blue Surf Design – Fabric-style textured back finish with slim curved design. Dolby Atmos Stereo Speakers – Dual stereo speakers provide immersive sound for movies and gaming.
